title: Evaluation tabs on Reliability and the Notebook, and notebook plots drawn in the app's own chart style
request: I want to plot everywhere in the app like this (the report's charts).
spec: A cell's plot came back as a matplotlib picture; Reliability and the Notebook had no evaluation.
plan: The same Evaluation panels as a tab on Reliability and the Notebook, one mount helper for every place
A cell shows a chart as data (chart_line, chart_bars), checked by the server and drawn by the page
The prompt tells the agent to use them; matplotlib stays for what they cannot draw

decisions.decision: A chart is data (kind, numbers, short texts), cleaned by the server, never markup.
decisions.why: The page draws only what it knows how to draw; a cell's output cannot inject anything.

decisions.decision: The store keeps a count of a cell's charts, not the points.
decisions.why: A chart's points can be a column's own values; the workspace's own record keeps them whole.

decisions.decision: The Research lab does not get the panels.
decisions.why: It is the repository's research across projects, not one model's results.

change: studio/kernels.py (HELPERS, clean_chart, chart outputs), store/keepers/standard.py (charts counted), prompts/notebook_cell.md, web/src/evaluation.js (mount, drawChart), views/models.html, reliability.html, notebook.html, evaluation.html, look.css, tests/test_notebook_cells.py.

findings.defect: A notebook plot did not look like the app's charts and could not be read as data.
findings.scenario: The person asked for an accuracy plot: a matplotlib picture with a legend over the bars.
findings.cause: The only way to plot in the kernel was a picture.
findings.fix: Two helpers in every kernel show a chart as data; the page draws it with the app's chart kit and the legend beside it.

measurements.name: A cell's chart in the browser
measurements.gate: the line chart draws with its legend outside the plot
measurements.result: two series over three folds drew with dots, ticks and a legend above; a bad spec said it was dropped
limits: drawn from a spec put on the page; a live agent cell was not asked for it (no model key in the scratch workspace)

outcome: Evaluation is a tab on Models, Reliability and the Notebook beside its page; a notebook cell can plot in the app's style.
lessons: Show output as data the page draws, not as a picture: it can match the app, be checked and be read by the store.
risks: The prompt changed: make agent-eval and make harness-eval must run before the gate.
